meta.title: Terms · Candy Heist
meta.description: The terms for booking Candy Heist: commissions and 1-1 sessions, how they're paid, and what happens if a session is missed.

label: Terms
intro: These cover everything booked and paid for on this site: commissions and 1-1 sessions with Candy Heist.

sections.heading: Payments
paragraphs: A commission takes half its price when you book it. The other half is due when the work is ready: Candy emails you an invoice, and you pay it on this site with its ID.
A 1-1 session is paid in full when you book it.
Card payments are handled by Stripe. Your card details never touch this site.

sections.heading: No refunds
paragraphs: All payments are final. Nothing is refunded: not a commission’s first half, not its second, and not a 1-1 session.

sections.heading: Moving a session, and staying in touch
paragraphs: If you need to move a 1-1 session, earlier or later, let Candy know in advance, by email, Discord or Instagram.
The same goes for a commission: if something changes on your side, tell Candy before it holds the work up.

sections.heading: If you miss it, or go quiet
paragraphs: If you don’t join a 1-1 session, or stop replying during a commission, without letting Candy know in advance, the booking ends there. What you’ve paid isn’t refunded, and the session or the commission doesn’t go ahead.

sections.heading: Booking a DJ set
paragraphs: An enquiry to book Candy Heist as a DJ isn’t a booking or a payment. The terms for a set are agreed with Candy directly.

sections.heading: Questions
paragraphs: If anything here is unclear, write to {email} before you book.
